details: On 2026-05-18 all 15 release tags of actions-cool/maintain-one-comment were moved to malicious commits in the same Mini Shai-Hulud operation (attributed to TeamPCP in MAL-2026-4161) that hijacked actions-cool/issues-helper, whose payload steals CI secrets and the workflow token and spreads by committing autostart hooks into the calling repository. Socket reports that all release tags of both actions resolve to malicious content, and that GitHub disabled both repositories on 2026-05-19, re-enabled them on 2026-09-16 with the tags unchanged, and disabled them again on 2026-09-25. Treat any workflow that used this action by tag since 2026-05-18 as compromised; only full commit SHAs of releases that predate 2026-05-18 are unaffected. No tag-to-commit mapping or payload sample has been published for this action specifically.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
